extracted.intended_audience: early-career academic peer reviewers (researchers asked to review manuscripts)
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance for early-career researchers on how to conduct professional, constructive peer reviews of academic manuscripts, including reviewer mindset, recommended structure, and working practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative_not_adversarial
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat reviewing as collaborative rather than adversarial; remember the editor, not the reviewer, makes the final decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: "we're all (supposed to be) on the same side" — frame comments to help improve the paper rather than to 'defeat' the authors; focus on aiding the editorial decision rather than acting as judge-and-jury.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professionalism_of_tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain professional tone: no snark or informality; write as you would face-to-face.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid rude, sarcastic, or flippant remarks. Use clear, respectful language; assume a real conversation with the authors or editor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constructive_criticism
rubrics_metrics.description: Give constructive criticism: explain shortcomings and suggest implementable fixes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When pointing out problems, offer concrete suggestions or directions for improvement rather than only negative statements; prioritize actionable feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidence_in_your_expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognize that being asked to review signals that your opinion has value; be confident in providing informed judgments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not undersell your perspective; provide clear reasoned assessments based on your expertise while acknowledging limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right_to_decline
rubrics_metrics.description: You may decline reviewing without penalty for conflicts of interest, lack of time, or poor fit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot provide a fair, timely review (e.g., conflict, overload, outside your expertise), notify the editor promptly so they can find an alternative reviewer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concise_summary_of_contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Start the review with a concise summary of the paper's contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a brief statement of what the paper claims to do or achieve to show you understood the manuscript and to orient the editor and authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge_strengths
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly acknowledge the paper's strengths early in the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight contributions, clarity, novelty, or other positive aspects so criticism is balanced and constructive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Major_criticisms_and_publication_barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: List major criticisms and any barriers that would prevent publication in current form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify substantive problems (conceptual flaws, fatal methodological issues, missing evidence) that must be addressed before acceptance; be clear which issues are blocking and why.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendations_and_conclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a clear recommendation or conclusion (e.g., accept, revise, reject) with justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize your overall judgment and link it to the major points raised; make it easy for the editor to see your rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Itemized_minor_corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an itemized list of minor corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List small issues (typos, wording, minor clarifications, formatting) separately from major criticisms to help authors fix the manuscript efficiently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brevity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep reviews concise and focused on the most important points; avoid excessive verbosity that buries key issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revisit_draft_after_delay
rubrics_metrics.description: Revisit your draft after a few days to gain a fresh perspective before submitting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allow time between writing and submitting the review to catch tone problems, clarify arguments, and ensure suggestions are practical and well-expressed.
